title: Halden: cold-leg recirculation
description: A finite source-transfer exercise on the fictional current four-loop PWR. Unit 2 starts at the standard full-power operating point. An explicit primary boundary break begins at +10 seconds, filling the containment sump while primary pressure falls. Run the model-scoped ES-1.3 to establish cooled sump supply through each RHR train, demonstrate direct low-head or same-train RHR-to-SI piggyback delivery at the actual receiving pressure, and isolate the four ECCS RWST branches in checked order. The task ends at an explicit continuing-duty handoff; it does not qualify strainer performance, NPSH, long-term recirculation or plant recovery.
objectives: Advance about two minutes to observe actual sump inventory and reactor shutdown; inspect current conditions before starting the task.
Run ES-1.3 on Unit 2. Verify actual cooled delivery before closing either source stage, then use the same-train piggyback paths to supply both SI pumps.
Compare ordinary wrong-order source closure, a stopped cooling train and an unavailable source with the accepted lineup; qualify actual delivery rather than valve commands alone.

guidance.title: Cold-leg recirculation
guidance.message: A primary release starts at +10 s. Advance about two minutes, inspect shutdown and actual sump inventory, then ask the Assistant to run ES-1.3 on Unit 2. It establishes cooled RHR and same-train SI delivery, checks source-transfer order, and ends with an operator handoff.
